examples.arabic: أيام العيد كانت قربت أوي وماتش مصر كمان.
examples.english: Eid days were very close, and Egypt's match was also coming soon.
examples.transliteration: Ayam el Eid kanet 2arabet awi w match Masr kaman.
examples.storyTitle: Eid Joy and the African Cup in Morocco

examples.arabic: سألته اخبارك ايه يا صاحبي فين ايام زمان
examples.english: I asked him: "How are you, my friend? Where are the old days?"
examples.transliteration: Sa'alto: akhbarak eh ya saHby? Feen ayyam zaman?

examples.arabic: خدت تليفونه عشان نتكلم أكتر الأيام الجاية
examples.english: I took his phone so we can talk more in the coming days.
examples.transliteration: Khaddt telefoono ashan netkallem aktar el ayam el gayya

examples.arabic: بابا بصلي وابتسم وقال فهمت يا بنتي انك بتحبي الايام دي
examples.english: Dad looked at me and smiled and said, "I understood, my daughter, that you love these days."
examples.transliteration: Baba basseli webtasam w 2al "Fahimt ya benti ennaky bet7ebbi el-ayyam di."

examples.arabic: صباح النور يا ام علي الغسالة بتاعتي بايظة والهدوم مكومة عندي بقالها ايام
examples.english: Good morning, Umm Ali, my washing machine is broken and the clothes have been piled up for days.
examples.transliteration: Sabah el-noor ya Om Ali, el-ghassāla beta'ty bayẓa wel-hedoom mekawwama 'andy ba'alha ayyam.

examples.arabic: ايام المطر بتبقى حلوة للقعدة مع العيلة في البيت
examples.english: Rainy days are nice for sitting with family at home.
examples.transliteration: Ayam el-matar beteb'a helwa lel-a'da ma'a el-'eila fel-bayt
